description: This file contains a function 'preinit_set_mac_address' that sets the MAC address of network interfaces based on device-specific configurations. It uses various external scripts and functions to retrieve MAC addresses from device-specific storage or configuration files, and applies these addresses during the pre-initialization phase of device boot.

methods.name: preinit_set_mac_address
methods.description: Sets MAC addresses for network interfaces based on device-specific configurations and hardware info, called during pre-initialization.

calls: ip link set dev eth0 address
ip link set dev eth1 address
